title: Why People Saw The Dress in Different Colours
description:
Your brain guesses the light before you see colour: cool daylight gives white and gold, warm indoor light gives blue and black.

The swatch colours are illustrative, not sampled from the real photo. "Subtracts the light" is a scientific hypothesis, not settled. Survey figures (1,401 people; 57% blue/black, 30% white/gold) are from Lafer-Sousa, Hermann and Conway, Current Biology 2015.

Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
